deliverables.text: A short written report: what in the scheduling spreadsheet is reliable, what is duplicated, and what is missing, with examples.
A map of how a booking moves from the first parent message to a confirmed lesson, with the places it gets stuck marked.
Firmer low-to-high ranges for Steps 2 and 3, with every assumption written out.
A {{walkthrough_minutes}}-minute walkthrough call to go through it together.

to_start.text: Share the scheduling spreadsheet (view access is enough) and an admin seat on the booking tool.

terms.title: The work
terms.body: I review the scheduling spreadsheet and the booking flow and deliver what is listed in Exhibit A. That is all Step 1 includes. Steps 2 and 3 are not part of this agreement; each needs its own written yes.

terms.title: Fee
terms.body: Step 1 is a fixed {{fee_step1}} for everything in Exhibit A, paid in full at signing. If it takes me longer than I planned, that is my cost, not yours.

terms.title: Timing
terms.body: I deliver within {{work_days|word}} working days after I have access, or after signing if that comes later. Delays on your side move the date by the same amount.

terms.title: Estimates
terms.body: Any ranges or estimates are my good-faith planning numbers for work I would do. They are not a quote, a fixed price or a promise. You may show them to anyone you like; nobody else can rely on them as a commitment from me, and they should travel with their assumptions attached.

terms.title: My opinion, not legal or compliance advice
terms.body: My findings are my professional opinion, for you to use as you see fit. They are not legal, tax or compliance advice, and the decisions remain yours.

terms.title: Fixes, and setup as is
terms.body: If something I deliver does not match Exhibit A, tell me within {{fix_window_days}} days and I will fix it. Any setup, formulas or configuration I hand over are provided as is, with no other warranty.

terms.title: Your data
terms.body: I use only the access you give me, keep it private, use it only for this work, and delete my copies when Step 1 ends. Please send no student records beyond what the spreadsheet already holds.

terms.title: What you own
terms.body: Once paid, everything I deliver in Step 1 is yours. I keep my own pre-existing tools, templates and methods.

terms.title: Limit of liability
terms.body: My total liability under this agreement is capped at {{liability_cap}}, and neither party is liable for indirect or lost-profit damages.

terms.title: Disputes
terms.body: Either party first raises a problem in writing and talks it through in good faith for {{talk_first_days}} days. After that, either can go to {{dispute_forum}}. Oregon law applies.

terms.title: Ending early
terms.body: I am an independent contractor. Either party can end this agreement in writing; if it ends early, I refund the part of the fee for work not yet done.

terms.title: The basics
terms.body: This is the whole agreement for Step 1. Changes must be in writing. E-signatures are fine.

altitudes.exec: A short paid check of the scheduling data for {{fee_step1}}, then ranges, not quotes, for the rebuild.
altitudes.strategic: Step 1 is the price of finding out; the rebuild is sized from what it finds, so neither side bets on a guess.
altitudes.operational: {{work_days|Word}} working days from access; results by {{deliver_by}} if access lands by {{access_by}}.
altitudes.tactical: Each of Dana's three questions maps to a deliverable or a field below.
altitudes.surgical: Every value, its source and its history; every assumption with the test that would decide it.

cold_read.why: LessonLoop's bookings are kept in a spreadsheet and a calendar tool that disagree, and parents phone to confirm lessons.
cold_read.what: A fixed-fee check of the data and the booking flow, with ranges for the rebuild.
cold_read.why_now: Dana wants bookings working before the January term, and the check has to finish first.
cold_read.before: Sign, share the spreadsheet and a booking-tool seat.
cold_read.during: {{work_days|Word}} working days of review; a walkthrough call at the end.
cold_read.after: Firmer ranges for Steps 2 and 3; each needs its own yes.
